description: Antigravity (agy) as a bare stateless engine node — the same three wakes as engine-agy, invoked with --permissions bypass. agy already runs unrestricted in the base preset, so this definition is identical to engine-agy today; the name states the intent, and it picks up any stronger mode agy grows. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account.
